headline: Binance Alleges Sophisticated Hack Involving Fake Job Interviews
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance published an investigation report revealing that hackers used fake job interviews in a sophisticated campaign to steal $6.3 billion.
why: Crypto exchange security and large-scale hacks pose systemic risks to digital asset valuations and regulatory compliance across the cryptocurrency industry.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The platform was targeted by a security breach.
